rawFinal: Accepted for focused testing under the original CargoGuard, bound to authored-source-05.json. The bounded source delta makes refresh_world_history_floor return an error for missing InventoryResource, return without touching configuration for Legacy/Unavailable/Fenced policies, and obtain RuntimeConfigResource fallibly only for Durable. It verifies the config uses the exact same allocator before any store scan or floor adjustment, retaining account-store writability, lock/scan/drop ordering and the initialized Session active-save scan. The added real bare-World/File-authority test covers missing inventory, Legacy without config, Durable without config and Durable with Legacy config; rejection requires allocator high-water to remain exactly unchanged. All 14 current source hashes and lengths match; the other 12 paths are unchanged from source04. Prior failed and superseded runs and review records remain intact; they are not added to the final source05 test total. No Cargo or UI was run by this reviewer. This is acceptance for the final source05 focused test round, not a claim that 177 tests passed or that public rollout is ready. Normal gateway/catalog activation, remaining fresh-item issuers, deployment-wide census and PostgreSQL authority remain prerequisites.
scope: Read-only verification of the two source05 changed paths, the existing initialized-Session save snapshot contract, and the 14-file manifest; only this separate work-directory review record was written.
